faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your UAE business. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Business setup in Dubai starts from AED 9,500 for a basic free zone license. Mainland setup starts from AED 14,500.

items.q: Can a foreigner 100% own a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can 100% own companies in most free zones and many mainland activities.

items.q: What is the cheapest free zone in Dubai?
items.a: RAK ICC, Ajman FTZ, and SRTIP offer the most affordable packages starting from AED 5,900.

items.q: How long does company registration take in Dubai?
items.a: Free zone registration takes 3-7 business days. Mainland takes 2-4 weeks.

items.q: Do I need a local partner in Dubai?
items.a: Not in free zones. In mainland, many activities now allow 100% foreign ownership.
